name: attraction-events-workshops
description: PLUGIN 9 — Events & Workshops that attract agents (Week 6). Live local events (masterminds, brokerage-neutral networking, AI and social workshops), virtual trainings, and evergreen webinars as a launch system: the strategy and format choice, the run-of-show, the registration page copy, the promo calendar with emails, DMs, texts, posts and stories (drafted, never sent), the attended / no-show / hot / cold follow-up sequences that move attendees into the pipeline, and analytics on registrations, show rate, conversations and calls booked per event. Reads the Agent Attraction Brain; requires Plugin 1; an offer still at seeds is fine — the close names what the member has to give so far, and Week 2 finishes the offer.
